contents.text: {"hypotheses":[{"experiment_id":"carry","text":"If Marchetti had carried the ball forward instead of shooting, the chance to score would have been higher (11.5% vs the actual 8.9%)."},{"experiment_id":"pass_H9","text":"If Marchetti had passed to Mateo Brann (CF) instead of shooting, the chance to score would have been lower (7.3% vs the actual 8.9%)."}]}
